definition: All512 full learned Exit rollouts, unchanged executable BID/ASK plus costs. Counterfactual same-entry sides are not simultaneous executable portfolio trades. Monthly rank halves exactly reproduce the predeclared hybrid diagnostic and are retrospective groupings, not an online trading rule. Actual Entry remains separate.

plan_criteria.conditional_ranking: One descriptive frozen-score comparison: max(Q_LONG,Q_SHORT)-Q_FLAT, chosen side argmax(LONG,SHORT); top versus bottom half within each TRAIN month, stable parent-ID ties, upper half ceil(n/2). Compare same rows against always LONG. No cutpoint search, threshold adjustment or fitting. Reused TRAIN evidence only; no generalization claim.
plan_criteria.entry_policy: Report actual Entry choices and one-position marked economics separately from hypothetical BOTH-side opportunities. Future best sides or profitable rows are never admissible Entry inputs.
plan_criteria.interpretation: Complete finite accounting is required. Positive counterfactual means do not prove a causal Entry strategy; negative side means alone do not rule out conditional edge. Report variation across all months, not selected winners.
plan_criteria.next_decision: Keep the learning gate unpassed unless improved causal Entry and Exit choices are established. Separately bind any later chronological check; no full epoch/VAL, CONTROL/TEST, trading, spending, cost change or teacher refresh.
plan_criteria.open_positions: Include every open position at its last executable liquidation value plus cashflows. The TRAIN cutoff is an observation boundary, never a forced model EXIT or maximum holding rule. Unknown source gaps remain non-authoritative and reported separately.
plan_criteria.paired_baselines: Same-entry immediate executable EXIT with identical quotes and costs, plus FLAT0. Aggregate and per-side/per-month net Bps, differences, decisions, and closed/open counts. Relative improvement alone is not positive edge.
plan_criteria.population: Exact existing TRAIN256, both counterfactual sides, all nine calendar months, in chronological order. No new selection or target fitting.
plan_criteria.question: Does the complete frozen ONLINE512 Exit policy preserve its conditional TRAIN improvement through consecutive decisions under the unchanged executable BID/ASK and slippage policy?
plan_criteria.resource_stop: One native three-hour observation window; any exhausted wall/forward/state budget is INCOMPLETE, not an economic rejection or completed evaluation. No automatic extension or relaunch.
